update_frequency: Monthly reports are described by the city as a monthly reporting requirement. Actual posting dates and archive completeness have not been verified; budgets and audits are annual document series.
title: Budgets and monthly finance reports
publisher: City of New Haven — Office of Policy, Management and Grants
description: Official city monthly reports describe budgeted and actual revenues, agency expenditures and year-end projections. Annual budgets and audits are available from a separate city index.
access: City report indexes and document downloads
formats: PDF budget documents (advertised by city index)
fields: The period represented by the selected report; exact document labels remain to be checked.
Report content described on the city's monthly-report page; not a verified export column.
Spending summaries by budgeted agency described by the city; exact table layouts remain to be checked.
Projections for the fiscal year, distinct from amounts already reported as actual.
Expected year-end budget result described on the monthly-report page.
steps: Open the official monthly reports page and select the fiscal year and reporting month you need.
For annual budget books and audit reports, use the Annual City Budgets & Audits page. Check whether each budget is proposed or Board-approved.
Open the original document and read its reporting period, headings, notes and units before using its figures.
For software use, inspect the actual document format and table layout. A spreadsheet export or API has not been verified by this directory.
contact: Office of Policy, Management and Grants; data-maintenance contact not confirmed.
limitations: Report contents are documented from the city's indexed monthly-report page. The exact files, latest available month, archive completeness and detailed column labels have not been verified.
The annual index advertises PDF budget documents. A ready-to-query CSV, spreadsheet export or API has not been verified; document tables may require manual reading or extraction.

The city's described monthly reports summarize revenues, budgeted agencies and projections. This description does not establish access to vendor-level payments, invoices or a complete transaction ledger.

Proposed budgets, approved budgets, actual figures and forecasts represent different things. Read each document's labels; do not treat projections as money already spent or combine cumulative periods as separate monthly spending.
Monthly reporting and annual audit documents have different purposes. This directory has not established their accounting basis or how their totals reconcile.
Direct requests to the city monthly-report page returned 403 in this browsing tool. Browser access may work; reliable programmatic retrieval is not verified.
next: Inspect a recent monthly report in a browser and document its format, exact fields, units and coverage.
Verify archive coverage, posting dates and any existing spreadsheets or supported API.
Confirm the city's published maintenance contact and document reuse terms.

evidence.note: Official indexed page describes required monthly report contents: revenues, agency expenditures, fiscal-year estimates and projected surplus/deficit. Direct retrieval returned 403.
Official indexed page lists proposed and Board-approved budget documents and audits, including PDF budget links. Current file downloads have not been tested.
